methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The well-known kinetic field technique [8] has been further improved to accurately predict sintering shrinkage for arbitrary time-temperature-cycles once a basic set of experimental data has been measured.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper discusses heat-treatment optimisation and material/process simulations, but does not identify or characterise an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: Recently a new large project, EnerTHERM, was started at HTL [6] extending the scope of previous research.

stage1.notes: ISO 50001 is contextual only; the described models predict material and process behaviour, not energy performance.
